wizard_recipe_hint: JGates only shows these commands; nothing runs on your machine without you.
wizard_docker_lead: JGates runs every check inside a container, without installing anything in your project or on your machine.
wizard_docker_ready: Docker {version} is running, with {memory} of memory and {cpus, plural, one {# CPU} other {# CPUs}}.
wizard_docker_in_image: JGates is already running inside its own tools: no Docker is needed here.
wizard_docker_polling: Checking every 3 seconds while this page is open.
wizard_docker_why_text: Each check runs isolated in a container with the JGates tools. Nothing gets installed on your computer, your project is never changed and everyone uses the same versions.
wizard_docker_other_text: Any Docker-compatible engine works, such as Rancher Desktop, Podman Desktop or Docker Engine on Linux. Choose the executable in the list above.
wizard_tools_lead: Download the JGates tools once: every check uses this same image. The download goes on in the background while you continue.
wizard_tools_in_image: The tools are already here: JGates runs inside them.
wizard_tools_left: about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
wizard_tools_background: It goes on in the background: you can move on to the next steps.
wizard_tools_lost: The server restarted during the download. Download again: what already arrived is reused.
wizard_project_lead: Check what JGates found in the project. Correct what is wrong; the rest is already filled in.
wizard_project_none: No component found. Declare a component or continue: the general checks run anyway.
wizard_project_services: Use the compose services for integration, e2e and runtime security tests
wizard_project_no_compose: No compose file found: the checks that need services wait for later.
wizard_profile_lead: Choose how much JGates checks. You can change it later, and every check can be adjusted.
wizard_profile_minimal_text: The essentials, fast, to get started.
wizard_profile_standard_text: Everyday quality, security and tests, without the slowest checks.
wizard_profile_strict_text: Everything that has a tool for this project; what does not apply shows with its reason, without blocking.
wizard_profile_runs: What runs: {count, plural, =0 {no check} one {# check} other {# checks}}
wizard_profile_strict_later: Strict becomes the recommended one once the tools finish downloading.
wizard_profile_customize_text: Each capability of the profile can be Required, Where a tool exists or Off. After saving, adjust that in Configuration, without editing YAML.
wizard_profile_preview_changes: Existing file: only the profile and the services change.
wizard_deps_lead: The project's dependencies are installed in separate volumes, never in the project folder. The first time takes a few minutes.
wizard_deps_none: This project has no dependencies to prepare.
wizard_deps_queued: They will be prepared as soon as the tools finish downloading.
wizard_deps_failed: Preparing some dependencies failed. See the component's log, try again or skip for now: the validation shows what stayed incomplete.
wizard_review_lead: Check what the first validation will do, and start it.
wizard_review_waiting: It will run as soon as the tools finish downloading.
wizard_review_plan: {count, plural, =0 {No check will run} one {# check will run} other {# checks will run}}
wizard_review_not_applicable: {count, plural, one {# item does not apply} other {# items do not apply}} to this project
wizard_review_armed: Agreed: the validation starts by itself when the preparation ends.
wizard_review_run_when_ready: Run as soon as it is ready
wizard_doctor_needs_you: I need you on one point below.
wizard_doctor_error: I could not examine the machine.
wizard_req_warn_note: Below the recommended does not stop you: only the larger checks may fail or take longer.
wizard_runtime_saved: Saved in your preferences: JGates now uses {runtime}, here and on the command line.
wizard_runtime_env: The variable JGATES_CONTAINER_RUNTIME ({value}) is set and wins over this choice while it exists.
wizard_step_locked: Opens once the {step} step is done.
wizard_steps_locked_note: The next steps open once you finish the {step} step.
wizard_tools_list: See the {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}}
wizard_data_lead: Databases of known vulnerabilities, kept in the {volume} volume and updated by JGates.
wizard_data_state_stale: Out of date, will be updated
wizard_data_state_missing: Will be downloaded with the tools
wizard_data_state_failed: The download failed: try again in Environment
wizard_tools_free: Free space on the engine's disk: {free}.
wizard_tools_free_low: Free space on the engine's disk: {free}; {missing} more is needed for everything to fit.
wizard_project_manager_none: No package manager for this language.
wizard_reopen_lead: The wizard opens with the current values. Nothing changes in the project until you confirm each step.
